title: Yummy Bouncy Tunisian Steak Tagine
description: A savory, kid-friendly Tunisian tagine with lean minced beef, slow-simmered to a bouncy-qq texture, perfect for a diabetic-friendly dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add minced beef, breaking it apart, and cook until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper, cooking for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Pour in water and lemon juice, bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot and let the mixture simmer until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens, about 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot over steamed couscous or whole-wheat pasta, sprinkled with fresh parsley.
